findings.evidence: Roadmap `Suggested.lean:102-104` and `README.md:182-184` require A′ to meet on-cycle singularities as a finite union of sectors, but this definition at lines 214-219 has no finiteness/isolation hypothesis; e.g. a real-valued curve `γ(t)=t*sin(1/t)` with `γ 0=0` and `S={0}` has infinitely many hits of `0`, while choosing the real line makes the perpendicular-distance term in `FlatOfOrder` identically zero at every hit.
findings.fix: Add an explicit finite/local-finite branch condition for each `s ∈ S` on `[a,b]` (including the basepoint), or strengthen the flatness API so condition (A′) packages a finite set of crossing times/branches with the required flatness order.
findings.issue: `ConditionAprime` only quantifies `FlatOfOrder` at each hit of `S`, and `FlatOfOrder`/`FlatOfOrderBasepoint` only require distance to some nonzero line to be `o(‖γ t - γ t₀‖^n)`; this allows infinitely many crossings of the same singularity, so it does not imply the advertised finite union of model sectors.

summary: `ConditionAprime` is too weak to represent HW condition (A′): it enforces pointwise line-flatness but omits the finite-sector/local-finiteness part that the roadmap requires.
